scope: Harris County (Houston, Pasadena, Baytown) - health & opportunity

records.name: Harris Health Financial Assistance Program (formerly Gold Card)
records.description_en: Helps Harris County residents with low income get care at Harris Health clinics and hospitals for free or a small copay.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Harris County residents whose household income is at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level. You may need to apply for Medicaid, CHIP or other programs first.
documents_needed: Photo ID for applicant and spouse
Proof of gross income for the last 30 days
Proof of relationship to dependent children
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or mail your application to Harris Health Financial Assistance Program, P.O. Box 300488, Houston, TX 77230. Applications are processed within 14 days. There is no fee to apply.
records.hours: Eligibility Call Center: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-4 p.m.; fourth Friday 8 a.m.-2 p.m.
records.cost: Free to apply; care at no cost or a small copay
records.notes: County indigent care program for Harris County. Harris Health is the payer of last resort, so screen for Medicaid/CHIP first. Report anyone asking for a fee to apply to the Compliance Hotline (844) 565-0621.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas de bajos ingresos que viven en el condado de Harris a recibir atención en clínicas y hospitales de Harris Health gratis o con un copago bajo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Harris con ingresos del hogar de hasta el 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Es posible que primero tenga que solicitar Medicaid, CHIP u otros programas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea o envíe su solicitud por correo a Harris Health Financial Assistance Program, P.O. Box 300488, Houston, TX 77230. Las solicitudes se procesan en 14 días. No cuesta nada solicitar.

records.name: Harris Health Baytown Health Center
records.description_en: A community clinic with primary care for adults and children, senior care, eye care, mammograms, psychiatry, counseling, lab and pharmacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Most insurance is accepted. People with low income who live in Harris County can apply for the Harris Health Financial Assistance Program.
records.how_to_apply: Call the appointment line to schedule a visit. Arrive 30 minutes early with your ID and medicines.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 7 a.m.-5 p.m. (second Thursday 7 a.m.-noon); pharmacy Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m. (second Thursday 8 a.m.-noon)
records.cost: Insurance accepted; low-cost or free with Harris Health Financial Assistance
records.notes: Main clinic line is (281) 837-2700; (713) 526-4243 is the Harris Health appointment line.
records.description_es: Una clínica comunitaria con atención primaria para adultos y niños, atención para personas mayores, cuidado de los ojos, mamografías, psiquiatría, consejería, laboratorio y farmacia.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Aceptan la mayoría de los seguros. Si tiene bajos ingresos y vive en el condado de Harris, puede solicitar el Programa de Asistencia Financiera de Harris Health.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de citas para hacer una cita. Llegue 30 minutos antes con su identificación y sus medicinas.

records.name: Harris Health Strawberry Health Center
records.description_en: A Pasadena clinic with primary care, urgent care, dental, mammograms, psychiatry, lab, pharmacy and social services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves adults and children. Most insurance is accepted. People with low income who live in Harris County can apply for the Harris Health Financial Assistance Program.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Harris Health appointment line at (713) 526-4243 to schedule. Urgent care is open weekdays until 8 p.m. Arrive 30 minutes early with your ID and medicines.
records.hours: Health center Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m. (third Wednesday 7:30-11 a.m.); urgent care Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-8 p.m.
records.cost: Insurance accepted; low-cost or free with Harris Health Financial Assistance
records.notes: Appointments: (713) 526-4243. Urgent care: (713) 218-2697. Walk-in applies to urgent care.
records.description_es: Una clínica en Pasadena con atención primaria, atención de urgencias, dentista, mamografías, psiquiatría, laboratorio, farmacia y servicios sociales.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a adultos y niños. Aceptan la mayoría de los seguros. Si tiene bajos ingresos y vive en el condado de Harris, puede solicitar el Programa de Asistencia Financiera de Harris Health.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de citas de Harris Health al (713) 526-4243. La clínica de urgencias abre entre semana hasta las 8 p.m. Llegue 30 minutos antes con su identificación y sus medicinas.

records.name: Ask My Nurse
records.description_en: A 24/7 nurse phone line that helps you decide if you need the emergency room, urgent care, or a regular doctor visit.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Harris Health patients with health questions.
records.how_to_apply: Call the number any time, day or night.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica con enfermeras las 24 horas, los 7 días, que le ayuda a decidir si necesita ir a emergencias, a urgencias o a una cita normal con el doctor.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para pacientes de Harris Health que tienen preguntas de salud.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número a cualquier hora, de día o de noche.

records.name: Legacy Community Health - Baytown Garth
records.description_en: A community health center (FQHC) with adult and child care, women's health, dental, vision, behavioral health, HIV care and pharmacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, regardless of ability to pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment, or call Legacy's main line at (832) 548-5000.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8 a.m.-5:30 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m.-6 p.m.
records.cost: Open to all regardless of ability to pay
records.notes: Legacy is the largest FQHC in Texas, with other Harris County clinics (Deer Park, Fifth Ward, Montrose, Southwest, Third Ward, Alief). Main appointment line (832) 548-5000.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario (FQHC) con atención para adultos y niños, salud de la mujer, dentista, visión, salud mental, atención del VIH y farmacia.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos, aunque no pueda pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita, o llame a la línea principal de Legacy al (832) 548-5000.

records.name: Avenue 360 Health & Wellness
records.description_en: Community clinics in Houston and Humble with primary care, children's care, women's health, dental, HIV care, pharmacy and counseling.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Community clinics open to the public. Call to ask about insurance, costs and payment help.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment at the clinic closest to you.
records.hours: Heights clinic: Monday-Thursday 8 a.m.-6 p.m., Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Call to ask about costs and insurance eligibility help
records.notes: Sliding fee policy not stated on the locations page. Other clinics: Midtown 2920 Fannin St. 77002; Spring Cypress 17010 Sugar Pine Dr. 77090 (281) 537-8627; Humble 18842 S. Memorial Dr. Ste 206, 77338 (281) 570-2525; Memorial City 902 Frostwood Ste 142, 77024 (713) 827-8266; Southwest 14095 South Main St. 77035 (832) 830-8345; plus a mobile clinic.
records.description_es: Clínicas comunitarias en Houston y Humble con atención primaria, atención para niños, salud de la mujer, dentista, atención del VIH, farmacia y consejería.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Clínicas comunitarias abiertas al público. Llame para preguntar sobre seguros, costos y ayuda para pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita en la clínica más cerca de usted.

records.name: El Centro de Corazón - Eastwood Health Center
records.description_en: A community health center (FQHC) in Houston's East End with primary care, children's care, women's health, dental and behavioral health.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves families in the East End and nearby Houston neighborhoods.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment.
records.notes: Other sites: John S. Dunn Health Center, 7635 Canal St., 77012; Magnolia Health Center, 7037 Capitol St., Ste. N100, 77011. Sliding fee details not confirmed on site.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario (FQHC) en el East End de Houston con atención primaria, atención para niños, salud de la mujer, dentista y salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a familias del East End y de vecindarios cercanos de Houston.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita.

records.name: San José Clinic
records.description_en: A clinic for people without insurance offering primary care, specialty care, dental, vision, pharmacy, behavioral health and lab services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income, uninsured people and families in Harris County and nearby counties. You must complete an eligibility interview first.
documents_needed: Birth certificate or Medicaid/CHIP card for children
Proof of household income (about one month of pay stubs or benefit letters)
Proof of address (any mail with your name and address)
records.how_to_apply: Call to set up your eligibility interview and first appointment. Scheduling is open Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.hours: Scheduling: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Sliding scale contribution based on income and family size (Federal Poverty Guidelines)
records.notes: Eligibility phone listed on eligibility page: (713) 490-2610. Medical (713) 462-0535; dental (713) 228-5716. Also accepts Medicaid, Medicare and ACA plans. Locations in Midtown Houston and Fort Bend; street address not confirmed.
records.description_es: Una clínica para personas sin seguro médico que ofrece atención primaria, especialistas, dentista, visión, farmacia, salud mental y laboratorio.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de bajos ingresos y sin seguro en el condado de Harris y condados cercanos. Primero debe tener una entrevista para ver si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer su entrevista de elegibilidad y su primera cita. Puede llamar de lunes a viernes, de 8 a.m. a 5 p.m.

records.name: HOPE Clinic
records.description_en: A community health center (FQHC) with adult, child and women's care, behavioral health, dental, vision, lab and pharmacy, serving many languages.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to all, including people who are uninsured or underinsured.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment at one of five Houston-area clinics (Beltway, Aldine, Aldine Meadows, Alief, West).
records.cost: Works with uninsured patients; ask about sliding fee
records.notes: Serves patients in many languages. Clinic street addresses and hours not confirmed.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario (FQHC) con atención para adultos, niños y mujeres, salud mental, dentista, visión, laboratorio y farmacia. Atiende en muchos idiomas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos, incluso personas sin seguro o con poco seguro.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita en una de sus cinco clínicas en el área de Houston (Beltway, Aldine, Aldine Meadows, Alief, West).

records.name: Denver Harbor Family Health Center
records.description_en: A community health center with family medicine, children's care, pregnancy care, dental and behavioral health.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to families in the Denver Harbor area and nearby.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-8 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario con medicina familiar, atención para niños, atención del embarazo, dentista y salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para familias de Denver Harbor y áreas cercanas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita.

records.name: Airline Children & Women's Health Center
records.description_en: A community clinic for children and women with medical, pregnancy, dental and counseling care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves children and women in north Houston.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8 a.m.-7 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m.-6 p.m.
records.description_es: Una clínica comunitaria para niños y mujeres con atención médica, atención del embarazo, dentista y consejería.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a niños y mujeres del norte de Houston.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita.

records.name: Healthcare for the Homeless - Houston
records.description_en: Medical care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, HIV prevention, street medicine and podiatry for people facing housing instability. No co-pays.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone facing any kind of housing instability. No ID or proof of homelessness is required. Insurance is not required.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main clinic to make an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m.-noon (clinics close 12-1 p.m. for lunch)
records.cost: No co-pay; insurance not required (insurance is billed if you have it)
records.notes: After-hours line available weekdays 5 p.m.-8 a.m. and weekends at the same number. Walk-in availability not stated; call first. Mental health crisis: call or text 988.
records.description_es: Atención médica, salud mental, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, prevención del VIH, medicina en la calle y cuidado de los pies para personas sin vivienda estable. No hay copagos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona que no tenga una vivienda estable. No se necesita identificación ni prueba de estar sin hogar. No necesita seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica principal para hacer una cita.

records.name: Houston Health Department - Northside Health Center
records.description_en: City clinics offering family planning, shots, TB care, STD care and dental care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. No one is denied care because they cannot pay; a sliding fee is available.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment at Northside, Sharpstown, or Sunnyside health centers.
records.cost: Sliding fee; no one denied for inability to pay
records.notes: Same phone for all centers. Other centers: Sharpstown Health Services, 6201 Bonhomme Rd. 3rd Floor South Tower, 77036; Sunnyside Health and Multi-Service Center, 4410 Reed Rd., 77051. Hours not listed.
records.description_es: Clínicas de la ciudad con planificación familiar, vacunas, atención de tuberculosis, atención de enfermedades de transmisión sexual y dentista.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público. A nadie se le niega atención por no poder pagar; hay una tarifa según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita en los centros de salud Northside, Sharpstown o Sunnyside.

records.name: Houston Health Department Dental Clinics
records.description_en: Preventive and repair dental care for children, young adults and pregnant women.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children and young adults 6 months to 21 years with Medicaid or no dental insurance, children 1-18 with CHIP, and pregnant women through 90 days after delivery.
records.how_to_apply: Call the dental appointment line for any location.
records.cost: Medicaid and CHIP accepted; call to ask about costs
records.notes: Locations: Magnolia multi-service center, Northside, Sharpstown, Sunnyside. Staff are bilingual.
records.description_es: Atención dental para prevenir y reparar problemas en niños, jóvenes y mujeres embarazadas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y jóvenes de 6 meses a 21 años con Medicaid o sin seguro dental, niños de 1 a 18 años con CHIP, y mujeres embarazadas hasta 90 días después del parto.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de citas dentales para cualquier clínica.

records.name: City of Houston WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies and young children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income pregnant, postpartum and breastfeeding women, infants, and children under 5 who are at nutritional risk. You must live in Texas; U.S. citizenship is not required.
records.how_to_apply: Call the WIC line or visit one of the 14 Houston WIC centers.
records.notes: Local WIC provider. Centers include Acres Homes, Airline, Aldine, Alief, Braesner, Denver Harbor, La Nueva Casa, Magnolia (address shown), Northeast, Northside, Northwest, Sharpstown, Southwest, Sunnyside. No Pasadena/Baytown centers on this list. Email hltwicinfo@houstontx.gov.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que acaban de dar a luz o que dan pecho, bebés y niños menores de 5 años, con bajos ingresos y riesgo de mala nutrición. Debe vivir en Texas; no necesita ser ciudadano de EE. UU.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de WIC o visite uno de los 14 centros de WIC en Houston.

records.name: Harris Center 24/7 Crisis and Access Line
records.organization: The Harris Center for Mental Health and IDD
records.description_en: The Local Mental Health Authority for Harris County. Call any time for a mental health crisis or to start mental health, substance use or IDD services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Harris County residents of any age. Services are not denied for inability to pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Crisis and Access Line any time to talk to a counselor or get connected to services.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.cost: Sliding scale based on family size and income; no one denied for inability to pay
records.notes: Local Mental Health Authority and Local IDD Authority for Harris County. Toll-free: (866) 970-4770.
records.description_es: La autoridad local de salud mental del condado de Harris. Llame a cualquier hora si tiene una crisis de salud mental o para empezar servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad intelectual y del desarrollo (IDD).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de cualquier edad que viven en el condado de Harris. No se niegan servicios por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Línea de Crisis y Acceso a cualquier hora para hablar con un consejero o para recibir servicios.

records.name: NeuroPsychiatric Center (NPC)
records.organization: The Harris Center for Mental Health and IDD
records.description_en: A 24/7 psychiatric emergency center for adults and children, with crisis stabilization, detox and substance use care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people of any age in a mental health or substance use crisis.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 Crisis and Access Line, or go to the center. In an emergency call 911 or 988.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.cost: Sliding scale; care regardless of ability to pay
records.notes: Walk-in process not described on the official page; call the Crisis and Access Line first if you can. In an emergency call 911 or 988.
records.description_es: Un centro de emergencias psiquiátricas abierto las 24 horas, los 7 días, para adultos y niños, con estabilización en crisis, desintoxicación y atención para el uso de sustancias.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de cualquier edad en una crisis de salud mental o de uso de sustancias.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Línea de Crisis y Acceso, abierta las 24 horas, o vaya al centro. En una emergencia llame al 911 o al 988.

records.name: Harris Center Southeast Community Service Center
records.organization: The Harris Center for Mental Health and IDD
records.description_en: Outpatient mental health care for adults and children, plus primary care, pharmacy and substance use services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Harris County residents who need ongoing mental health care.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Crisis and Access Line to schedule an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Sliding scale; no one denied for inability to pay
records.notes: Closest main clinic to Pasadena. Other clinics: Northeast 7200 N Loop E Fwy 77028; Northwest 3737 Dacoma St 77092; Southwest 9401 Southwest Fwy 77074. Also has Pasadena ISD school co-locations.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental para adultos y niños, además de atención primaria, farmacia y servicios para el uso de sustancias.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Harris y necesitan atención de salud mental continua.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Línea de Crisis y Acceso para hacer una cita.

records.name: MHA of Greater Houston Helpline and Care Connect
records.organization: Mental Health America of Greater Houston
records.description_en: Call or text to get free help finding mental health or substance use care, and ask about free therapy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone in the Greater Houston area looking for mental health help.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text the helpline.
records.notes: Main office line (713) 523-8963. Also offers free online mental health screenings and veteran support. Helpline hours not listed.
records.description_es: Llame o mande un mensaje de texto para recibir ayuda gratis para encontrar atención de salud mental o de uso de sustancias, y pregunte por terapia gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona en el área de Houston que busca ayuda de salud mental.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un mensaje de texto a la línea de ayuda.

records.name: Crisis Intervention of Houston Crisis Hotline
records.description_en: A free 24/7 crisis and suicide prevention hotline, plus a teen talk and text line.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone in emotional distress, including teens.
records.how_to_apply: Call the hotline any time. Teens can call (832) 416-1199 or text (281) 201-4430.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.notes: Office address and phone (713) 533-4500 are administrative; help is by phone and text.
records.description_es: Una línea gratis de crisis y prevención del suicidio, abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días, y una línea para adolescentes por llamada o texto.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona que se sienta muy mal emocionalmente, incluidos los adolescentes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora. Los adolescentes pueden llamar al (832) 416-1199 o mandar texto al (281) 201-4430.

records.name: Houston Area Women's Center Hotlines
records.description_en: Free 24/7 hotlines for domestic violence and sexual assault, plus counseling, safety planning, supportive housing, and legal help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For women, children and families affected by domestic violence, sexual assault or sex trafficking.
records.how_to_apply: Call the domestic violence line (713) 528-2121 or the sexual assault line (713) 528-7273 any time.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.description_es: Líneas gratis abiertas las 24 horas para violencia doméstica y agresión sexual, además de consejería, planes de seguridad, vivienda de apoyo y ayuda legal.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres, niños y familias afectados por violencia doméstica, agresión sexual o trata de personas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de violencia doméstica (713) 528-2121 o a la línea de agresión sexual (713) 528-7273 a cualquier hora.

records.name: Child Care Scholarships (Child Care Financial Aid)
records.description_en: Helps pay for child care so parents can work, go to school or job training, or look for work.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families with income up to 85% of State Median Income (for example, up to $7,670 a month for a family of four, Oct 2025-Sept 2026). There is currently a wait list.
documents_needed: Proof of U.S. citizenship or legal status for each child
Income for the last 13 weeks for all working household members
School/training information for household members in school
Child care provider name and address
records.how_to_apply: Create an account and apply online through the Texas child care portal. The support center processes complete applications in about 20 days.
records.hours: Support center: Monday-Friday 7 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Free to apply; parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Local Workforce Development Board (Gulf Coast region, includes Harris County). Text line: (346) 249-7700. Children up to 19 with a documented disability may qualify.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, estudiar, tomar capacitación o buscar trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias con ingresos de hasta el 85% del Ingreso Medio del Estado (por ejemplo, hasta $7,670 al mes para una familia de cuatro, de octubre 2025 a septiembre 2026). Ahora hay una lista de espera.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cree una cuenta y solicite en línea en el portal de cuidado de niños de Texas. El centro de apoyo procesa las solicitudes completas en unos 20 días.

records.name: HCDE Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Free early learning programs for babies, toddlers and preschool children to get ready for kindergarten.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Early Head Start serves children 6 to 35 months; Head Start serves children who are 3-4 years old on September 1, 2026. Families must meet program requirements.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online (English or Spanish) or call. Now accepting applications for the 2026-2027 school year.
records.notes: Serves north and east Harris County. Early Head Start application: https://headstart.hcde-texas.org/apply-for-early-head-start
records.description_es: Programas gratis de aprendizaje temprano para bebés, niños pequeños y niños de preescolar para prepararlos para el kínder.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Early Head Start es para niños de 6 a 35 meses; Head Start es para niños que tienen 3 o 4 años el 1 de septiembre de 2026. Las familias deben cumplir los requisitos del programa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea (en inglés o español) o llame. Ya aceptan solicitudes para el año escolar 2026-2027.

records.name: BakerRipley Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Free early learning for infants, toddlers and 3-4 year olds, with meals, supplies, and diapers and formula for Early Head Start.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Early Head Start is for babies 6 weeks to 2 years; Head Start is for children 3-4. Families must meet federal poverty-based income rules. A home-based option serves pregnant women and children under 3.
documents_needed: Child's birth certificate (or doctor's pregnancy letter for home-based)
Proof of address (lease or utility bill)
records.how_to_apply: Call or apply online. Applications are accepted all year.
records.hours: Programs run Monday-Friday 7:45 a.m.-3 p.m.
records.notes: 32 locations across Harris and Fort Bend counties.
records.description_es: Aprendizaje temprano gratis para bebés, niños pequeños y niños de 3 y 4 años, con comidas y útiles escolares, y pañales y fórmula en Early Head Start.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Early Head Start es para bebés de 6 semanas a 2 años; Head Start es para niños de 3 y 4 años. Las familias deben cumplir los límites de ingresos federales. Un programa en casa atiende a mujeres embarazadas y niños menores de 3 años.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o solicite en línea. Aceptan solicitudes todo el año.

records.name: AVANCE-Houston Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Early Head Start (ages 0-3) and Head Start (ages 3-5) early learning programs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children birth to 5 in Houston. Families are placed on a waiting list until a spot opens.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online pre-application, or call. You will be contacted when a center has space.
records.notes: Income rules and cost not listed on site; ask when applying.
records.description_es: Programas de aprendizaje temprano Early Head Start (de 0 a 3 años) y Head Start (de 3 a 5 años).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños de 0 a 5 años en Houston. Las familias quedan en una lista de espera hasta que haya lugar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la presolicitud en línea o llame. Le avisarán cuando haya lugar en un centro.

records.name: HISD Free and Reduced-Price School Meals
records.description_en: Free breakfast for all HISD students, and free or reduced-price lunch for families who qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Breakfast is free for all students. Most schools (CEP) serve free meals to all students; at non-CEP schools, lunch aid depends on household income and families must apply.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through SchoolCafe. All families are encouraged to apply.
records.notes: Eligibility email: eligibilityinfo@houstonisd.org. For 2026-2027, 33 campuses are non-CEP.
records.description_es: Desayuno gratis para todos los estudiantes de HISD, y almuerzo gratis o a precio reducido para las familias que califican.
records.eligibility_summary_es: El desayuno es gratis para todos. En la mayoría de las escuelas (CEP) todas las comidas son gratis; en las escuelas que no son CEP, la ayuda para el almuerzo depende de los ingresos y las familias deben solicitar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en SchoolCafe. Se recomienda que todas las familias soliciten.

records.name: Pasadena ISD Free School Meals
records.description_en: Breakfast and lunch are free for all Pasadena ISD students in the 2026-2027 school year.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All Pasadena ISD students. No application needed.
records.how_to_apply: No application needed. Call Nutrition Services with questions.
records.hours: Office Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m.
records.notes: Email nutritionservices@pasadenaisd.org.
records.description_es: El desayuno y el almuerzo son gratis para todos los estudiantes de Pasadena ISD en el año escolar 2026-2027.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos los estudiantes de Pasadena ISD. No necesita solicitar.
records.how_to_apply_es: No necesita solicitar. Llame a Servicios de Nutrición si tiene preguntas.

records.name: Goose Creek CISD Free and Reduced School Meals
records.description_en: Free breakfast for all students, and free lunch for students approved as free or reduced-price.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Breakfast free for all students. Lunch aid is for families approved through the meal application (reapply every school year).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through Nutri Apps or get a paper application at your school office.
records.notes: Serves Baytown area. Reduced-price students eat lunch free this school year.
records.description_es: Desayuno gratis para todos los estudiantes, y almuerzo gratis para estudiantes aprobados para comidas gratis o a precio reducido.
records.eligibility_summary_es: El desayuno es gratis para todos. La ayuda para el almuerzo es para familias aprobadas con la solicitud de comidas (hay que solicitar cada año escolar).
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en Nutri Apps o pida una solicitud en papel en la oficina de su escuela.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Baytown Career Office
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, writing a resume, getting job training, and applying for child care aid and unemployment help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone looking for work or training.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during office hours or call the office.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Local Workforce Solutions board. Main line 1-888-469-5627.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo, hacer su currículum, recibir capacitación y solicitar ayuda para el cuidado de niños y el desempleo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para cualquier persona que busca trabajo o capacitación.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite la oficina en horario de atención o llame a la oficina.

records.name: Training and Education Scholarships
records.description_en: Helps pay for job training in fields like health care, construction, manufacturing, energy, education and technology.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers, career changers and recent graduates who qualify under federal workforce (WIOA) rules.
documents_needed: Proof you can work in the U.S.
Proof of income or public assistance
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit a career office to schedule a career assessment.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar capacitación para trabajos en salud, construcción, manufactura, energía, educación y tecnología.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo, quieren cambiar de carrera o se graduaron hace poco, y que califican bajo las reglas federales de empleo (WIOA).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite una oficina de empleo para hacer una evaluación de carrera.

records.name: Goodwill Houston Career Centers and Job Connection
records.description_en: Free help with career planning, resumes, interviews, computer lab use, job skills training and job matching.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with barriers to employment. Call to ask if you qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call or use the online locator to find a career center near you.
records.notes: Address/phone are corporate offices; use the site's ZIP code search for the nearest center.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para planear su carrera, hacer su currículum, prepararse para entrevistas, usar computadoras, aprender habilidades de trabajo y encontrar empleo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con obstáculos para conseguir trabajo. Llame para preguntar si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o use el buscador en línea para encontrar un centro de empleo cerca de usted.

records.name: SERJobs Skilled Trades Training
records.organization: SERJobs (SER-Jobs for Progress of the Texas Gulf Coast)
records.description_en: Free job training in skilled trades and construction, apprenticeships, YouthBuild, and help for veterans and people with justice involvement.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people from low-income communities, including justice-impacted people and veterans. Program rules vary.
records.how_to_apply: Click Apply on the SERJobs website to fill out the application form.
records.notes: Serves Houston, Galveston and Fort Bend. Phone and street address not confirmed. Cost not stated on homepage.
records.description_es: Capacitación en oficios y construcción, aprendizajes pagados, YouthBuild, y ayuda para veteranos y personas con antecedentes penales.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de comunidades de bajos ingresos, incluidas personas con antecedentes penales y veteranos. Las reglas cambian según el programa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga clic en Apply en la página de SERJobs para llenar la solicitud.

records.name: Lone Star Legal Aid - Houston Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for people with low income, such as housing, family and benefits problems. No criminal cases.
records.eligibility_summary_en: You must meet income and legal status rules. Call or apply to find out if you qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online any time, call during phone intake hours, or walk in.
records.hours: Office Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; phone intake Monday-Thursday 8:30 a.m.-2:30 p.m.; online any time
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 733-8394. Civil cases only; no criminal cases.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como problemas de vivienda, familia y beneficios. No atienden casos penales.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Debe cumplir las reglas de ingresos y de estatus legal. Llame o solicite para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea a cualquier hora, llame en el horario de solicitudes por teléfono o vaya a la oficina.

records.name: Harris County Eviction Defense (Right to Counsel)
records.organization: Lone Star Legal Aid with Harris County Housing & Community Development
records.description_en: Free lawyers for tenants facing eviction in any Harris County Justice of the Peace court, including advice before a case is filed.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Harris County residents with household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Guideline who are facing eviction.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text APPLY to (361) 358-4428. On your court date, arrive 30 minutes early to talk to Lone Star Legal Aid staff.
records.notes: Phone is 361-35EVICT. Harris County HCD lists Lone Star Legal Aid at (832) 927-4955 for this program (https://hcd.harriscountytx.gov/Residents/Legal-Services/Eviction-Defense-Program). Priority for those on unemployment or with income loss.
records.description_es: Abogados gratis para inquilinos que enfrentan un desalojo en cualquier corte de Juez de Paz del condado de Harris, incluso consejos antes de que se presente el caso.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Harris, con ingresos del hogar de hasta el 200% de la Guía Federal de Pobreza y que enfrentan un desalojo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un texto con la palabra APPLY al (361) 358-4428. El día de su corte, llegue 30 minutos antes para hablar con el personal de Lone Star Legal Aid.

records.name: Houston Volunteer Lawyers
records.description_en: Free volunteer lawyers for civil problems like evictions, family law, protective orders, guardianship, probate and contractor disputes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible low-income residents of the Greater Houston area.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online questionnaire or call. You can also email info@hvlp.org.
records.description_es: Abogados voluntarios gratis para problemas civiles como desalojos, asuntos de familia, órdenes de protección, tutela, herencias y problemas con contratistas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de bajos ingresos del área de Houston que califican.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el cuestionario en línea o llame. También puede escribir a info@hvlp.org.

records.name: Community Resilience Rental Assistance Program
records.description_en: Case management and help with resources for households at risk of eviction or homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low- to moderate-income Harris County households at risk of eviction or homelessness.
records.how_to_apply: Apply through 2-1-1 Texas: call 2-1-1 or visit 211texas.org.
records.notes: Listed as open. Income limits not stated. Harris County HCD Housing Support Intake: (832) 531-6041, Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-1 p.m.
records.description_es: Manejo de casos y ayuda con recursos para hogares en riesgo de desalojo o de quedarse sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares del condado de Harris de ingresos bajos a moderados en riesgo de desalojo o de quedarse sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite por medio de 2-1-1 Texas: llame al 2-1-1 o visite 211texas.org.

records.name: BakerRipley Utility Assistance Program
records.description_en: Helps pay electric, gas or propane bills (not water) for families with low income.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households in Harris, Brazoria and Galveston counties under the income limit (for example $23,940 for 1 person or $49,500 for 4 people).
documents_needed: Social Security card for all household members
Proof of citizenship or legal residency
Proof of income for the last 30 days for all adults 18+
records.how_to_apply: Apply online when the portal is open, or call the hotline to book an in-person appointment.
records.notes: Online applications were closed when checked (capacity reached) and expected to reopen Monday, November 9; in-person appointments start Monday, October 27. One application per household per year; results within 6 weeks.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas o propano (no agua) para familias de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares en los condados de Harris, Brazoria y Galveston que están bajo el límite de ingresos (por ejemplo $23,940 para 1 persona o $49,500 para 4 personas).
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea cuando el portal esté abierto, o llame a la línea de ayuda para hacer una cita en persona.

records.name: METRO Reduced Fare Programs
records.organization: Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County (METRO)
records.description_en: Half-price bus and rail fares for students, seniors 65-69 and people with disabilities, and free rides for seniors 70 and older.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Students (K-12 and college), seniors 65+, and people with disabilities.
documents_needed: Government-issued photo ID with date of birth
Students: class schedule or report card (K-12) or proof of college enrollment
Disability: doctor's statement, visible mobility disability, or service-connected Veteran ID
records.how_to_apply: Upload your documents through the METRO Online RideStore (card is mailed), or bring them to a METRO RideStore.
records.cost: 50% off ($0.60 per ride) or free for 70+
records.notes: No low-income/SNAP discount listed on the fares page. Phone accepts calls or texts.
records.description_es: Pasajes de autobús y tren a mitad de precio para estudiantes, personas de 65 a 69 años y personas con discapacidad, y viajes gratis para personas de 70 años o más.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes (de kínder a 12.º grado y universidad), personas de 65 años o más, y personas con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply_es: Suba sus documentos en la METRO Online RideStore (le mandan la tarjeta por correo), o llévelos a una METRO RideStore.
